Sentry

Connect a software failure to the user journey it affects.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Sentry helps engineering teams understand application errors and performance with context from the running product. We can configure monitoring around the user journeys that matter, such as sign-in, lead submission, checkout, or report loading. The practical outcome is an issue workflow that identifies affected releases, gives engineers useful diagnostic context, and keeps noisy alerts from obscuring meaningful failures.

Useful outputs

  • Configured monitoring and release association
  • Actionable alert and issue workflow
  • Documented diagnostic and resolution process

Where we can apply it

  • Release monitoring: deployment → error context → assigned investigation → verified fix.
  • Checkout diagnosis: failed request → trace inspection → engineering action.
  • Product quality: recurring issues → prioritization by impact → release validation.
01

Use case 1

Capture frontend and backend errors with useful release context.

02

Use case 2

Investigate slow or failing product journeys with supported tracing.

03

Use case 3

Route important incidents to an owner and track resolution after a release.

Inputs we need

  • Application runtime and critical journey map
  • Privacy rules and acceptable diagnostic fields
  • Incident owners and severity thresholds

Delivery sequence

  • Install suitable SDKs and define permitted diagnostic data.
  • Associate events with environments and releases and reduce unnecessary noise.
  • Test representative failures and confirm escalation reaches the right owner.

Expert review points

  • Review sensitive data collection and redaction.
  • Verify alert thresholds identify user impact rather than every minor event.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
